cells.remarks: Registers the grant, by the king, of the village Vijavaṭṭi in the Guntur district, the tax due thereon to Vishṇu-śarman of the Gautama-gōtra and the Chhandōga-śākhā.

cells.date: Śaka 520, Kāla-yukta, Vaiśākha, amāvāsyā, Thursday, Vyatī-pāta.
cells.remarks: Registers the gift, made by the king, of the village called Hoḍalūru in the Vāgade Seventy district in the Kuṇḍi-chha-Thousand province, to a Brāhmaṇa named Kēśava-Bhaṭṭa of the Kāśyapa-gōtra who was well-versed in many Śāstras and the occasion while he had gone after his coronation festival. The grant appears to be a spurious one.

cells.date: Śaka 1105, Śōbhakṛit, Āśvayuja, amāvāsyā, Monday, Vyatīpāta.
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the village called Kuḷkuṇṇuru to 1,000 learned Brāhmaṇas who belonged to various gōtras. The grant is said to have been composed by Tribhuvanamalla-chakravartī Ādityadēva, written by Paṇḍita Lakshmīdhara and engraved by Paṇḍaya. Published in Indian Antiquary Vol. IV, pp. 274ff; but no plates are here.

cells.date: Śaka 1546, Rudhirōdgārin, Mīna, śu. pūrṇimā, Sunday, Hasta, lunar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Kāḷapūttūr alias Tirumala-bhūpāla-samudram in Triśirah-palli-vishaya, made by the king to a number of learned Brāhmaṇas, at the request of his subordinate Tirumala-nātha.
Registers the rates of contribution made on the various articles of merchandise, for the upkeep of the temple of Koṇḍakapīśvara at (Tanjore) by the several classes of merchants (of the locality).

cells.date: Śaka 1656, Kali 4735 (wrong for 4835) expired, Rākshasa, Kārttigai 26, Hasta, Thursday, daśamī.
cells.remarks: Records the voluntary contributions in paddy and rice made by the communities of the ārukarai and the koṭṭiyakkārae for the ardhajāma offering of the goddess Jñānāmbikā-Annapūrnēśvari, in the temple of Koṇkaṇēśvara, by the efforts of Āyam Veṇkōji-Paṇdita.

cells.king: Kharagraha (I), younger brother of Śīlāditya alias Dharmāditya.
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of two wells (vāvī-dvayam) (names not clear) made by the king to the Brāhmaṇas, Tuṭṭa, son of Brāhmaṇa [un]gupta, who belonged to the Kauṇḍinya-gōtra and the Vājasanēya-śākhā. The dūtaka of the grant was Dharasēna and the scribe was Śōbhana, son of vigrahādhikṛita and Divirapati Va[tra]-Bhaṭṭi.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT. / SAIDAPET TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kōyambēdu.—On the west wall of the central shrine in the Kođungālišvara temple.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement made by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple, a subdivision of Puliyūr-kōṭṭam alias Kulōttuṅga-vaḷanāḍu in Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam, to burn a perpetual lamp in the temple for a gift of 12 Bhujabalap-puḍamāḍai made by Pallikoṇḍān Tiruvēgambamuḍaiyān, the Iḷaṅgōvan of Sirrukkāḍu in the same nāḍu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers a similar agreement to burn a twilight lamp in the temple for a gift of a cow and calves made by a resident of Tirunāvalūr in Tirumunaippādi-nādu, a subdivision of Nađuvil-manđalam.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Registers a similar agreement of the Śivabrāhmaṇas to burn 2 perpetual lamps for a gift of 24 Bhujabalap-puḍamāḍai left in their charge by a certain Uyyavandān, of the Śivapādamaḍai-māḍiśan Vāṇavāyaṇ of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south and east walls of the same shrine.
cells.date: 22nd " (in words) [date-calculation appendix, No. 4: VIJAYANAGARA—cont. Venkaṭapatirāya. Śaka 1546, Rudhirōdgārin, Mina, śu. paurṇimā, Friday, Hasta, lunar eclipse = A.D. 1624, March 24, Wednesday (not Friday as given in the inscription) ; 72 ; 48 ; lunar eclipse.]
cells.remarks: Registers a similar agreement for a gift of 12 Bhujabalap-puḍamāḍai made by Dēvāyaḷ, wife of Karuppuḷan Vāṇḍaikkāḷiñjan Vāḍugaṇāthan of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the same shrine.
cells.date: 37th " (in words) [date-calculation appendix, No. 5: Pratāpasimha-Mahārāja. Śaka 1680, Kali 4859, Bahudhānya, Vaiyāśi 30, Friday = A.D. 1758, June 9, Friday.]
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of two plots of land as tirunandavanap-patī made tax-free, for a flower-garden to the temple, by the lady mentioned in No. 4 above, after purchasing it from the temple.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.date: 25th " (in words) [date-calculation appendix, No. 6: TANJORE MAHRATHAS. Ēkōji-Mahārāja. Śaka 1656, Kali 4735 (wrong for 4835, expired), Rākshasa, Kārttigai 26, Hasta, Thursday, daśami. = A.D. 1735, November 27, Thursday, (ba. 10) ; f.d.t.·33; f.d.n.·08.]
cells.remarks: Registers a similar agreement given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas to burn a twilight lamp in the temple for a gift of two cows and two calves made by a certain Śivapādan Poṇṇambalakūttan Śelvan of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers a similar agreement given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas to burn a twilight lamp in the temple for a gift of two Bhujabalap-puḍamāḍai made by Eriyāṇḍāḷ, daughter of Karuppuḷan Vāḍugaṇāthan.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT. / SAIDAPET TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: States that the assembly (ūr) of Kōyambēḍu made an agreement to burn a twilight lamp in the temple for the different kinds of produce, for the maintenance of the midnight service which was about to be discontinued.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement given by the Šivabrāhmanas to burn a twilight lamp in the temple for a gift of 2 cows and three calves made by Kalji-ānđān alias Tirunāna-sambandavēlān, son of Pēraiyan, a resident of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers a similar agreement given in return for a gift of money made by a lady named Umāyaṇḍāḷ of Tirumullaivāyil.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the first prākāra, (outside), right of entrance, in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers another agreement made by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple to burn 3 twilight lamps for the money and cows received by them from three residents of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Köyambēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a well in the temple for the sacred bath of the god, by the lady mentioned in No. 4 above.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT. / SAIDAPET TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Portion lost. Seems to register a gift of land made for offerings to the god during the early morning service. Mentions Sāḷuva Tippayadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT. / SAIDAPET TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: States that two shepherds (maṇrādi) of Sā[t]*taman-[gala]m in Puliyūr-kōṭtam made Kārikkōṇ, son of Sūryakkōṇ, as the tiruviļakkukkuđi of the temple. An unfinished inscription on a stone in the flooring near the Nandi in the same temple dated in Šaka 1742 (A.D. 1820) records some provision made for the maintenance of a chatram.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Poṇṇēri — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the step at the entrance into the central shrine of the Agastyēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. The characters are of about the 9th century A.D. Seems to record an endowment made for the maintenance of a person capable of teaching one Vēda including the Paviliyam (Babhuricha) and the Āraya.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Tiruvā-ppāḍi (hamlet of Poṇṇēri) — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone set up near the dhvajastambha in the Kari-Krishṇa-Peru[mā]l temple.
cells.remarks: States that this is the chakra-stone set up to mark the village Ālāđu-Vairamaṅgalam which had been given as the śrōtrīyam for the conduct of worship in the temple of Kariya-Krīshṇasvāmi at Tiruvāyppāđi in Ponnēri. Ponnēri is said to be situated in the Jāghir-sima granted to the English Company (East India Company) in the Subā of Nabābu Surāju-Daula.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Chiṅtāmaṇi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab now used as a lintel of the entrance into the ardha-maṇḍapa of the Chiṅtāmaṇīśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Characters belong to the 10th century A.D. Seems to register provision made for offerings and worship in the temple of Tiruppagavaṇrurai-Āndār from the produce of 2520 kuļi of land, with effect from the 3rd year of a king whose name is lost.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Chiṅtāmaṇi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the same Chōḷa maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by purchase made to the temple of Mahādēva at Tiruppagavaṇrurai (sacred as) the Gōkarna of the West Coast, by Kuđitāngi Patṭālakaṇ, who stipulated that the tenants of this land should annually supply oil to the temple at the rate of 10 nāli for every half-site.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK · Chiṅtāmaṇi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another pillar in the same Rāshtrakūṭa place.
cells.remarks: States that, on the representation of the assembly (ūr) of the village Kaṇuṅgali, the chief Muṇaippāḷi-Mūvendavēḷār ordered that the fines maṇḍapāḍu, daṇ-ḍam and kaṟṟam levied in the village should as before be utilized for the temple. It is also stated that accordingly these fines were utilized for providing oil for lamps in the temple. Also states that the drummer of the temple was granted some doḷas of fish.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / SAIDAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the lintel over the entrance into the central shrine of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a sale of land which was endowed for worship in the temple. Mentions Āraṇi-āru. The writing is of the 10th contury A.D.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK · TIRUVALLUR TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Veļļāttukkōṭtai.—On a stone set up near the tank-weir.
cells.date: Vyaya, Tai 4, Wednesday, (Māgha 3, in Telugu). [date-calculation appendix, No. 21: ANONYMOUS. Vijaya, Tai 4, Wednesday, (Māgha, śu. 3-in Telugu), The characters belong to the 19th century A.D.; and Vijaya, Tai 4 corresponded to Wednesday, January 15th A.D. 1834.]
cells.remarks: Modern. States that this (probably the tank-weir) was the gift of Ellamma, the mother of Koṇdama-Nāyaka Varadappa-Nāyaka of Toṇda-maṇ(alam).

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / TIRUVALLUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a rock half-way up the hill to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Gives the name Viragaṅgattaṭṭān Vadugan Pašuvaṇ. The writing is of the 13th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT. / WALAJAPET TALUK. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pulivalam.—On a pillar in the deserted Šiva temple.
cells.remarks: States that the Šivabrāhmanas agreed to burn a twilight lamp for a gift of one kūbu made by Tillaiyāļi, a Veļļāla of Pulivalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · PULLAVAM † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another pillar in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Mentions Tirukkarapuram-uđaiya-Mahādēva.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · PULLAVAM † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south and north walls of the central shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Tirukkarapuram-uđaiya-Mahādēva and Sōļakulasundari-chaturvēdimaņgalam in Őgaivala-nādu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On two pieces of a broken slab lying before the deserted Perumāḷ temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions oil-mill with the income of which a lamp has to be burnt in the shrine of Virrunda-Perumāḷ at Puḷalvām, through the efforts of two subordinates (manushya) of Āliya Mallappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · PULLAVAM † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Below the image of Vēṇugōpāla-svāmin sculptured on a slab set up near a tank.
cells.remarks: States that the tank was constructed by Raņgarāja, son of Sāļuva Annāmalairāja in the name of (god) Gōpi-nāthadēva.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · VĀYIJAVŪRŪR — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the central shrine in the Valavanēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: States that the commission of certain taxes on lands belonging to the several temples in Kalavai-parru, from the 7th year of the king's reign, were remitted.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.date: Śaka 1260, 17th year, Kanṇi, Ba. 8, Tuesday, Tiruvāḍirai. [date-calculation appendix, No. 29: MISCELLANEOUS. Sakalalōkachakravartin Veṇrumaṇkoṇḍa Śambuvarāya. Śaka 1260, 17th year, Kaṇṇi, ba. 8, Tuesday, Tiruvādirai. = A.D. 1338, September 8, Tuesday ; 20; 56.]
cells.remarks: Records that the accountancy rights in Śivapādakēśakhara-chaturvēdimangalam alias Vāyijavūrūr in Mōyūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Paḷkampa-kōṭṭam in Jayangoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam, were sold for 300 paṇam to Nityakalyāṇa-Bhaṭṭar, the son of the temple priest, by the village headman, bent Akkāli-Bhaṭṭan had died without issue. This amount was reserved as fund for repairs to the Vēṇugōpālan-maṇḍapa and another structure called Aḷipāḍai-maṇḍapa and for the maintenance of the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · VĀYIJAVŪRŪR † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Ālambūnđi to the temple of Vaļava-Nayinār in the village Vaļavanātūr by a certain Bayyapa-Nāyaningāru, for the merit of the king.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · VĀYIJAVŪRŪR — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1461, Vikāri, Makara, śu. 10, Punar-pūśam. [date-calculation appendix, No. 31: Achyutadéva-Mahardya. Saka 1461, Vikari, Makara, gu. 10, Friday, Punarpigam. Su. 10 and nak. States that since Ālampāđi and Veṭṭitāngal, two hamlets of Vaļavanārrūr were got as tirunāmattukkāņi to the temple of Vaļavišvaram-uđaiya-Nayinār by Pāppu-Redđi through the intercession of the officer Vaiyappa-Nāyaka with the king, he was granted by the temple authorities, the kānip-parķu tenure over these villages.

cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Kuṭṭiyam alias Rājānārāyaṇanallūr, free of taxes, as gaṇḍa-gaṇa-eriti to Eḷumbōḍan Gaṅgaiyāḍi Mādayan, an accountant, for the merit of the king, as he had carried the ashes of Veṇrumaṇḍa Śambuvarāya to the Ganga and performed the śrāddha at Gayā.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · KUṬṬIYAM † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of land, free of taxes, made by the king for the offerings, worship, etc., to the image of the god mentioned above, in the name of the chief's father Ekāmbaranātha Veṇrumaṇḍa Śambuvarāya.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Kilnāḷ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a rock below the Subrahmaṇya temple on the hill.
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the money realised from the fish lease of the tank at Minnal by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Uliya Mallappaḍōva-Mahārāya for the maintenance of the tank-bund.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Kilnāḷ † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On four sides of a stone set up in the village.
cells.remarks: Records the amount payable by the settlers of the village Aḷiñjāḷ-puṇḍalam alias Muṇṇal founded in the name of Poṇṇin-Perumāḷ with effect from the month of Paṅguṇi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Kilnāḷ † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Ādikēśava-Perumāḷ temple.
cells.remarks: Records gift of 120 kalam of paddy for repairing the tank and the archway of the temple of Ādikēśava-Perumāḷ temple at Muṇṇal by a certain Naṅgaippillai Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷa-Brahmādhirāyan.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Vellore — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in a street at Gaṇḍapuram.
cells.remarks: Fragment. The writing is of the 12th century A.D. Seems to refer to the death of Gaṅga-Seṭṭi and to an enquiry regarding this, involving a certain Kajami-Seṭṭi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Tepmahādēvamaṅgalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north and west walls of the central shrine in the Kajal-kaṇḍīśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Śōvvaṇa-Nāyaka, the agent of Śāḷuva Narasiṅgadēva-Nāyaka and the temple of Śādiravichāka-Perumāḷ.

cells.place: On the south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Built in in places. Registers the sale of the kāmiyātchi right of Šivanpadavantāngal, a dēvadāna village of Trišūlaparvatanātha, for 150 pānam, by two individuals who gave this amount for the construction of a car to the god Karaikantīšvaram-uđaiya-Nayinār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Tepmahādēvamaṅgalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south walls of the same shrine.

cells.remarks: Built in in the middle. Seems to register a gift of land for the requirements of the temple of [Karaikan]tīšvaram-uđaiya-Nāyanār at Mādēvimaņgalam in Paņgala-nāđu, a subdivision of Palkuņra-kōtťam by Puliya.... who is called the 'Kumāra' of the king.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Tepmahādēvamaṅgalam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the mahā-maṇḍapa of the same temple.

cells.remarks: Registers the gift of land in the village of Āḍaiyāḷamaṅgalam in favour of the temple by Āḍaiyāḷamaṅgalam-Nāyaka with the permission of the king.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Tepmahādēvamaṅgalam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.date: Šaka 1459, Hēvilambi, Kumbha, šu. 7, Sunday, Uttiraťđadi. [date-calculation appendix, No. 42: Saka 1459, Hévilambi, Kumbha, éu. [7], Sunday, Uttirattadi Irregular. éu. 7 cannot combine with Uttirattaidi in the month of Kumbha.]
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the villages [Tiravāḷpuram and Timmapuram to the temples of Karuṇākāntīśvara-udaiya-Nāyinār and Śādiravichāka-Perumāḷ by Vāsava-Nāyaka, son of [I]pya-Nāyaka for the merit of the chief Vai-.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa.

cells.remarks: States that this mahā-maṇḍapa was constructed by Vāsava-Nāyaka, son of Aḍḍappaṁ Īśvara-Nāyaka.

cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.date: Šaka 1458, Durmukhi, Mina, šu. paurnimā, Monday, Haste. [date-calculation appendix, No. 44: Śaka 1458, Durmukhi, Mina, śu. paurṇimā, Monday, Hasta = A.D. 1537, March 26, Monday ; 66; 22.]
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. cells.location: NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / WALAJAPET TALUK · Tepmahādēvamaṅgalam — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Krīshṇappa-Nāyaka and some land given as udirappaṭi.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Cheyyār river.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land by Puttarāyiāđi for (the maintenance of) the tank dug by Šōkā[ra]ṇ Anṇāvaṇ Pākkadi Karai[vā]yāṇ of Mādēvamaṅgalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · TENMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On a slab set up in a field near the hamlet Aruṇagirimangalam.
cells.date: Šaka 1475, Paridhāvin (expired), Pramādicha (current), Chittirai 19, Rōhiṇī, trītīyā, Saturday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 52: Śaka 1475, Paridhāvin (expired), Pramādicha (current), Chittirai 19, Rōhiṇi, tritiyā, Saturday. = A.D. 1653, April 15, Saturday, (Śu. 3) ; 99; 91.]
cells.remarks: The last few lines are built in. Records the formation of a pīļaiyam in Aruṇagirimaṅgalam, a kānipparru in the dēvamaṇdalam of god Anṇāmalaiyār, in the name of Tirumalaidēva-Mahārāja, by Mahāmaṇdalēšvara Rāmarāja Venkaṭappadēva-Mahārāja, and the settlement of some families therein on certain terms.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM
cells.place: On the west wall of the central shrine in the Mahādēviśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Registers the remission of the taxes on Seṭṭis, oil-mongers (vāṇiyar), washermen, etc., in favour of the temple, for completing the shrine of Tirukkāmakkōṭṭamuḍaiya-Nāchchiyār-paḷḷai-perṛār which had been left incomplete.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.language: Tamil and Telugu. †
cells.remarks: This is a bilingual inscription registering the construction of (a tank called) Rāmasamudram and the grant of wet lands watered by its channels, as sarvamānya to provide for offerings, worship and repairs in the temple, by Sāļuva Narasaiyar for the merit of his father Rāmaya-Nāyaka, the mugappāvāđai of the king. Mādēvimaṅgalam is referred to as an independent village in Muruga-maṅgala-parĵu situated within (the district of) Rājagambhīraṇ-malai in Jayaṅgoṇđaśōļa-maṇdalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Seems to register a gift of land in Sāḷukāḍi in Paḍaivīṭu-rājya by a certain sthāna-Nāyaka as the gift of the king for lamps and the Tiruvāḍirai festival of the god. Mādēvi-mangalam is referred to as a village in the northern subdivision of Paṅgala-nāḍu in Paḷkampa-kōṭṭam, a district of Jayangoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On the west wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Registers a sarvamānya gift of land in Dēvasamudram in the village of Vāyijavūr, for the merit of Vāyijavūr-Piḷḷai-yār situated on the way to Paḍaivīṭu. The writing belongs to the 15th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT
cells.place: On the south wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Verse in praise of god Šiva characters belong to the 14th century A.D.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM
cells.place: On the south wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers a similar measurement (alanavai) for dry lands. On the west wall of the central shrine is found a similar measurement for wet lands.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM
cells.place: On the south wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers an order of the king to the trustees of the Gīta-gōpāla temple at Vāyijavūr, that the lands of Mādēvimangalam and Puttinuvaiyappa-paṭṭar of Tiruninruyevanallūr, made tax-free, for worship, offerings and lights in the temple. Enumerates the several kinds of taxes and therefore that were remitted.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Portion lost in the middle. Registers a tax-free gift of lands as bhaṭa-vritti to three persons by the Mahāpradhāni (name lost) of the king.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On a stone set up in a street
cells.remarks: Registers the remission, by the king, of the taxes due from the village Mādēvimangalam in favour of the temple, for the requirements of the shrine of the goddess Nallānpillaiperṇār.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On a slab set up in another street.
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Registers the remission, by the king, of some taxes due from the residents and new settlers of the villages Mādēvimangalam and Taninruyevanallūr, situated in the favour of the temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · VAḌAMAHĀDĒVAMANGALAM †
cells.place: On a slab set up near the tank to the west of the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged in the middle. Registers the remission, by the king, of taxes due from the village Murugamangalam in favour of the temple of Mayilādudēva, situated in front of the royal palace at Padaiviđu.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT
cells.place: On a rock near the sluice of the Oṭṭiyantāṅgal tank in the same village.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · Nara nakuppam

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · Vājiyūr
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Vēḍiyappan temple.

cells.location: NORTH ARCOOT DISTRICT · Vājiyūr †

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Echchūr — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Registers an agreement made by the Mudalis, Mādhavamādhava-chaturvēdimangalam in Amūr-kōṭṭam, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḻa-maṇḍalam, for the welfare of Rājakkal-Nāyaṉār (i.e., the king), undertaking the payment of the taxes due on 1 vēli of land belonging to Rājakkal-Nāyaṉār, situated in the hamlet of Kūḷippākkam [in] taudalam, the southern hamlet of the village, thus making it a nāṟṟippaṟṟi.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Āmūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Vighnēśvara temple.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Śirudāvūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the dilapidated Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of 12 sheep to supplement the 78 sheep already presented by a certain person to support for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Parāśararāma-viṇṇagar-Ālvār at Narasimhamangalam in Amūrkōṭṭam, by Dēvāraṅgaṉ of Puṇṇaiyāvil in Ārvakākkūṟṟam on the southern bank of the river Kāvēri in Śōṇāḍu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of the same shrine.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land, free of taxes, as tirumadattukkāṇi to the temple of 'Parāśarāma-viṇṇagar-Ālvār' also called Narasimgha-chaturvēdimangalam. It is also called Narasimgha-chaturvēdimangalam.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: cont. CHINGLEPUT TALUK—cont. Śirudāvūr—cont. On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land for offerings during two additional (early morning and midday) services of the god, by Pāśaiyāḷi of Kārimangalam in Kiliyūr-nāḍu situated on the southern bank (of the river Kāvēri) in Śōṇāḍu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall (on either side of the entrance) of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 9th century A.D. Mentions Šaťti-Vin-nagaram and Pānđimānikkamarasa . . . son of Kāvalampākkilār.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a beam in the mahā-maṇḍapa of the dilapidated Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: States that this beam (pōdigai) is the gift of Pichchādai, son of Te[n*]navadaraiyaņ. The writing belongs to the 16th century A.D.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers a gift of land for offerings during the early morning service of the god Bhūtīśvaram- Uḍaiyār at Śirudāvūr alias Narasimgha-chaturvēdimaṅgalam by Kumaṇan of Āmūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records an agreement given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple to burn a perpetual lamp before the deity for the sheep received by them from a Brahman of the village.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement given by the Dēvadānis of the temple, to pay to it a specified rate of kadamai on the produce of the lands at Śirudāvūr and Āmūr, which were presented to it as dēvadāna by Śōḷamān Piramban Oṟṟi parigraham-uḍaiyāṉ and his two brothers, who were the parigraham-uḍaiyāṉ of the village. cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land, as tirumadattukkāṇi to the temple of Vachchup-Piḷḷaiyār at Śirudāvūr by Aḷagiyakōttan, after purchasing it from the temple authorities. cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers a remission of some specified taxes on two vēli of dēvadāna land belonging to the god and the temple of the temple. Śirudāvūr is here referred to as part of Āyiravēli-paṟṟu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.date: 7th year (in words), Mēsha, śu. paurṇai, Sunday, śōdi.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land, by order of the king through his officer (mudali) Piḷḷai Iruṅgōḷar, on several pieces of land purchased by the temple authorities and the nyāyattār of the village from a certain Rājēndraśōḷa-Tagadūraiḍaiyāṉ and others for the requirements of the goddess Araṇavaḷi-Nāchchiyār in the temple.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers a sale of land, made tax-free, by the assembly of Tiruvāḍi in Amūr-kōṭṭam to the assembly of Tiruvēgambamuḍaiyān of Ārivalūr in Kiḷaiy-kurram, a subdivision of Nittavinōda-vaḷanāḍu, who presented it to the temple for offerings during the midnight service of the god. The record is a copy of an earlier temple record of Vikrama-Chōḷadēva, dated in the 10th year.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple to burn a twilight lamp before the deity, the gold being received by them from Tiruvāḍi Bhuvanēśvaran, a resident of Tiruvāḍi.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land made tax-free, after purchase, for providing for additional offerings during the three services to the god Bhūtiśvaram-Uđaiyār by Pālaipāni, the donor mentioned in No. 86 above.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On six stray stones found scattered in the compound of the same temple.
cells.remarks: The writing belongs to the 13th century, A.D. Records the names of donors who presented paving and other stones to the temple evidently during construction. One of these was Širāļadēvan alias Taniningruvenrān-Pallavaraya, son of Nambiyār, one of the parigrahattūr of the village, who made such a gift for the manđapa of Kūtādumdēva (Natarāja). The other donors were (1) Nambi-Āļvān, son of Tiruvarasu-tigal-ninrān, (2) Pennāgada-udaiyān Pichcha, (3) Šiyapilļai, younger sister of Tanāsīrāyar, (4) Tiruvadaiyār and (5) Uđaiyālvār, son of Kidārattaraiyar.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On three other stones found in the same place.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Śālai-kalam-aruttu etc. Registers gift of sheep, left in charge of the sabhā for the purpose of burning a perpetual lamp in the temple, by the person mentioned in Nos. 86 and 97 above, who also presented a lamp-stand.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar lying in the same place.
cells.remarks: States that this pillar and (an image of) Pilļaiyār (Vināyaka) were the gift of Peruńkānđai Taichchujān. The writing belongs to the 15th century A.D.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers the formation of an agrahāra by Maḷḷappa-Nāyaka, the agent of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Immadi Dōrātta . . . Nārāyaṇanāyaka-Mahārāya for the merit of his master.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a broken pillar planted in the same village.
cells.remarks: Fragment. The characters belong to the 13th century A.D. Registers a grant of the āyam taxes on the dēvadāna and other lands at Śīrudāvūr including Koṇḍampākkam as they existed previously, for feeding the Śivabrāhmaṇas at Śīrudāvūr-tiru-maḍam in Kāḷiyūr Perumbarrappuliyūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone set up in the same village.
cells.remarks: States that this agaram was the gift of the Nāṭṭār.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · Ālattūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field near the tank.
cells.remarks: The inscription is highly damaged. Seems to register a gift of land under the tank made to the god at Ālattūr by Ševvana, the agent of Tātteya, and the Uravar of Ālattūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · Kīshpankārapai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in the village.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Registers the gift of the village Kāranai to Kariyamāṇikka-Emberumān for the merit of (king) Venkatapatirāyar-Ayyan.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT · Pattippulam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in the village.
cells.remarks: Registers the royal order remitting the taxes on the village Pattippulam in Āyiravēlip-pagru in favour of the temple of Mudalīšuram-udaiya-Nāyanār at Kālinga-rāyarūr alias Tajuvakkujaindān-nallūr, which was separated from Širudāvūr, to provide for worship and repairs in the temple.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT—cont. / CHINGLEPUT TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:
Pattipulam.—cont.
On the same slab (reverse)
cells.remarks: A Telugu version of No. 106 above.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Achecharavākkam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Agastiśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land as archanābhōga to Agattiśrittēvar (Agastiśvara) by a certain Śańkaṇ, after purchase.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Mađaiyāttūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field (Survey No. 160) near the tank.
cells.remarks: The characters belong to the 13th century A.D. States that Mađaiyattūr alias Śiruvidāyāṭam of (the god) Ālagiyamapavāla-Perumāl.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another slab in a field called Vijakkađi (Survey No. 53).
cells.remarks: States that this (land) is a kuđi-nīṇgū-dēvadānam. The characters are of the same period as No. 109 above.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Acharavākkam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone lying in another field (Survey No. 156).
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land in Maḍaiyattūr by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Ella[māri] Mahārāja. The characters are of the 16th century.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Śembākkam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in the village.
cells.date: Šaka (wrong for Kali) 4461 (in words), Plavaṅga, Śimha, šu. 5, Tiruvōṇam. [date-calculation appendix, No. 112: Saka (wrong for Kali) 4461 (in words), Plavanga, Sirhha, éu. 5, Tiruvénam. In the reign of Sadasiva the cyclic year Plavanga fell in Kali 4668-(Saka 1469) = A.D. 1547. The given details are not regular.]
cells.remarks: Registers gift of lands in different villages as mađap-puṇam to a certain Tirutōṇriyappar [O]kriyappar by Peddu-Nāyaka, the agent of Kavaramalai Virūpāksha-Nāyaka.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Śembākkam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another stone set up in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to fix the rate of certain kinds of taxes like purakkaṭaṇai, tarikkađamai, etc., payable by the residents and new settlers of the village, by order of Aṇpappillai, who bears a number of bīrudas such as Rūjasēkharaṇ etc. The characters are of the 16th century. A damaged inscription on another stone in the same village dated in Jaya, Puratṭāśi 13, seems to register a grant of land by Ellappaṇ, the agent of Aṇnap..... to Rāmaliṅgaya-Nāyanār.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Rāyappāṭṭu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up on the tank bund.
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that the tank at Rāyalapaṭtu was the gift of Perundēvi-Ammāl, mother of Chidambara-Mudaliyār, who was the son of Chinnatambi-Mudaliyār of Vallam in ŠeṅgaJunīrparṇu-śirmai and belonged to the Kulattulār-gōtra.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Kōṭṭamēḍu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the dilapidated Vishnu shrine.
cells.remarks: States that Kulattulān Tiruvēgambamuđaiyān Sāmantappillai of Śirukuṇṇam constructed of stone (kalkārat-tiruppaṇi) the temple of Tiruvirunda-Perumāl at Kōṭtaivēđu alias Nallanāyaka-chaturvēdimaṅgalam.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Kōṭṭamēḍu † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Jalakaṇṭhēśvara temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of house-sites by two individuals for providing dīpūrādhanā to the god Jalakanthēśvara.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Tirumēṇīśvara temple.
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Registers a mānya gift of land to Poyiyāda-Pillaiyār by the mahājanas of Nāga-samudram alias Kōṭtaimēđu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Vembēḍu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in the village.
cells.date: Śaka 1445 (for 1455), Vijaya, Mēsha, śu. 10, Friday, Mṛigaśīrsha. [date-calculation appendix, No. 118: Saka 1445 (mistake for 1455), Vijaya, Mésha, éu. 10, Friday,Mrigaséirsha. er su 10 and nak. Mrigasirsha cannot combine in the month of - 8818. 0 . cells.remarks: In modern characters. Registers the gift of the village Agaram, separated from Vembēḍu in Śeṅgalunīrpaṭṭu-śīrmai, situated in Iraṇḍāyiravēli-parru in Kumuḷi-nāḍu, a subdivision of Amūr-kōṭṭam, at (the) request of (the) agent of Tyāgapparumāḷ-Mudaliyār, an agent of Timmi-Nāyaka and the accountant, (of the village).

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Tiruppattūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of the central shrine in the Subrahmaṇya temple.
cells.remarks: Gives the situation of the different shrines and the images therein, in the temple of Kandasvāmi at Samayapura (Tiruppattūr) in Toṇḍai-nāḍu.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Tiruppattūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the Divyānai-amman shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Subrahmaṇyadeva at Tiruppattūr in Kumiḷi-nāḍu, a subdivision of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḻa-maṇḍalam, to burn 5 twilight lamps from two persons in return for the cows received by them.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Tiruppattūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Stones lost at the end. Begins with the introduction Pūmādu puṇara etc. Registers a gift of land, free of taxes, by the assembly (Ūrār) of Śembākkam alias Paṇḍitachōḷanallūr, for the sake of the celebration of festivals in the temple of Subrahmaṇya-dēva.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Tiruppattūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east, north and west walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Stones misplaced and some lost. Registers a gift of a vēli of land by the residents of the village to the assembly (mahāsabhā) of Kāyāru alias Kāyāru-chaturvēdimangalam in Kumiḷi-nāḍu, a subdivision of Āmūrkkōṭṭam, in Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḻa-maṇḍalam, to provide for offerings and lamps and other requirements in the temple of Piḷḷaiyār Subrahmaṇyadēva at Tiruppattūr.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Tiruppattūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Damaged at the beginning. Registers the grant of a vēli of land, as tax-free dēvadāna, to the temple of Subrahmanyadēva at Tirupp[oriyū]r (probably by the king).

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT / CHINGLEPUT TALUK · Tiruppattūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Beginning lost. The writing belongs to the 12th century A.D. Seems to register a gift of land made after purchase by a resident of Iḷanallūr, for conducting the mid-night service in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Alagiya-Vōṅkaṭēśapperumāḷ temple at Paḻaṅkāśinallūr (hamlet).
cells.date: Śaka 1340, Viḷambi, ṛikshika, ha 10, Wednesday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: States that the Nātitavar of Kuṇṭattūr-valanādu alias Ādaṇūr-paṭru in Kurukkai-kūṭṭam, a subdivision of Tirumuṇaippādi-nādu in Malādu alias Jaṇanātha-valanādu received 20 panam from Āṭkoṇdadēvar, son of Alagiyanāyaṇār of Vāgūr in Karumūr-paṭru, for lands called Malaiyamāṇ-ēndal alias Taṇiāṇmaivallāṇ-ēndal sold to him for providing for the expenses of daily worship and of a perpetual lamp in the temple of Alagapperumāl at Ādaṇūr. The document mentions Chavuṇḍaya-Uḍaiyar, under whose orders the gift was made.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa behind the Divyā-pālaka image (right of entrance).
cells.date: Šaka 1337, Manmatha, Mina, šu. 3, Monday, Aśvati.
cells.remarks: Registers that the Ūravar of Ādaṇūr (names mentioned), sold lands in Kādanpatṭu as tirunāmattukkāṇi to the temple of god Alagapperumāl at Ādaṇūr for 88 panam endowed by Ādittarasa-Uḍaiyar. Mentions Annadāta-Uḍaiyar with whose permission the transaction was recorded on stone.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall (left of entrance).
cells.date: Šaka.... Virōdhikrit, Mēsha, šu. .., Friday, Rōhiṇi.
cells.remarks: The record is much damaged. Seems to give the details of the lands in Pāchchil which belonged to several persons in Ādaṇūr, which were sold to a certain Āṭkoṇdadēvaṇ, who endowed it to the temple. Some of these owners of lands also figure as members of the Ūr in No. 126 above. A certain Śiluppa-aruśar is mentioned in the record as witness to the document.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:

VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK—cont.
Ādanūr—cont.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the outer mandapa in front of the temple.
cells.remarks: States that the mandapa erected by Kachchivēndayan (entrance-door) to (the temple of) Alagar as Ādai (Adanūr) was built by Vanniyan of Tiraisai.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the stone lintel of the entrance into the same mandapa.
cells.remarks: States that the mandapa erected by Kachchivēndayan (entrance-door) to (the temple of) Alagar as Ādai (Adanūr) resembled the coronation mandapa of Śrī-Rāma.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab used as a step in front of the Tayār shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Much damaged and incomplete. Seems to register certain concessions to the temple of Alagar, given by Kālī[g]arāya (?) and Kaṇḍiyadēva, the king officers to the maṇḍāgis living in some specified areas, who had left the place being unable to pay the taxes.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Paśupatiśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 12 sheep made by Śattan..... of Kampamaṅgalam for a twilight lamp in the temple of Iraviśvaramuđaiya-Mahādēva at Tiruvāmūr.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records a similar gift of 12 sheep made by Śōruđaiyāl for a twilight lamp in the temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Beginnings of lines built in the temple. Registers a gift of 90 sheep made by the king's officer for a twilight lamp in Tiru-viśvaram-udaiya-Mahādēva at Tiruvānmūr in Tiru-muṇaippāḍi-nāḍu, a subdivision of Rājēndrachōḷa-vaḷanāḍu by Māṇikkapperiyāraiayan of Kiḷkkarai-kkuḍi in Rājēndrasiṅga-vaḷanāḍu, (for the merit of) his son Śatti.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records that the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple agreed to burn a twilight lamp before the deity (the gift of) 12 sheep made by Tiruvārangam, the kiḷatti (wife) of a certain Viraiyaṇ-Śōṇan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north and west walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records that the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple agreed to burn a twilight lamp before the deity (the gift of) 12 sheep made by Tiruvārangam, the kiḷatti (wife) of a certain Viraiyaṇ-Śōṇan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: States that Tirumāldēvan of Kanichchapākkam made a gift of an atṭanaikkāl (a cross-legged stand) and a dūpakkāl (incense burner) to the temple, and also provided for the supply of betel-nut and leaves to the deity. Tirumunaippādi-nādu is stated to be a subdivision of Gaṅgaikonđaśōla-valanādu.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pugalmādu etc. States that the ṭerir of Tiruvārūr in Kīḻaimār-nāḍu of the Kīḻaimār-nāḍu sold one vēli of land, made tax-free, for the provision of offerings and a perpetual lamp to the (temple) of Tirunāvukkaraiyadēvar (in the temple), and that this land was left in the charge of two Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple who agreed to supply the required quantity of paddy etc.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Begins with the introduction Tirumanni valara etc. The record apparently registers some gift (details of which are lost) made to the temple by the residents of the village.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT. VRIDDHACHALAM TALUK. Āḍanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone set up in the Iruppai-tōppu grove, two furlongs from the village.
cells.remarks: Modern. States that three kāṇi of land with the iluppai and mango trees was the gift of Mutta-Reddiyār made for the expenses of burning lamps before the images of the god and Apparsvāmi.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · Vēṅgaḍampāṭṭi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the step in the gōpura in front of the Vishnu temple.
cells.remarks: Modern. A verse in praise of a certain Ragasin̄gan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · Eydanūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Commences with the historical introduction Pugalmādu etc. Records the receipt of money received from the 28th year of the king by the Śivabrāhmaṇas from Tiruvayindran Viraiyan, the Meykāvalan of Eydanūr, for burning lamps in the temples of Tirumandurai-Āṇḍār at Śōḷakulavallinallūr in Paṭṭaṇakkūṟṟam and of Vaḍatali-Mahādēvar, Durgaiyār and Gaṇapatiyār in the same village.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · Eydanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of No. 141 above. States that the Śivabrāhmaṇa Tiruvēkambam Māpiṅga-Bhaṭṭan agreed to burn twilight lamps to the same god for the money received by him from the donor mentioned above.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · Eydanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine.
cells.remarks: Built in at the right end. Seems to record a gift of money for the purpose of burning two twilight lamps in the temple. Another inscription is dated in the 35th year of the king and states that provision for another twilight lamp was made by a certain Viraiyaṇ-Sōṇan.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · Eydanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: States that the Śivabrāhmaṇas agreed to burn a twilight lamp in the temple of Tirunanduraiyār Kulōttuṅga-śōḷa-Īśvaramuḍaiyār for an endowment by the general (ēṇādi) Araiyaṉ Śaṅkaraṉ-Tamiḻavēḷāṉ.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · Eydanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Commences with the historical introduction Pugalmādu etc. Built in at the right end. Registers an agreement given by the Šivabrāhmanas to burn a twilight lamp in the temple in return for a gift of paddy made by Tiruvayindraņ-Viraiyaņ (mentioned in No. 141 above). Mentions also the provision made in the 31st year of the king for burning twilight lamps in the same temple.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT— · Eydanūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers that Nambi Śiriyāṉ alias Kulōttuṅgaśōḷa-Mūvēndavēḷāṉ made provision for a twilight lamp in the temple of Tirunandurai-Mahādēva by the gift of 12 sheep to a maṇḍāḍi.

cells.place:

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TANJORE TALUK · TANJORE TALUK. Tiṭṭai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the west and south walls of the central shrine in the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the kāval-rights in the temple of Tiṭṭai to Tiruvēṅkaṭamuḍaiyāṉ who was attached to the temple of Tiruvēṅkaṭa-uḍaiyār-Nayiṉār.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TANJORE TALUK · TANJORE TALUK. Tiṭṭai † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Purports to be a royal order issued to the dēvadāna of the temple of Tiṭṭai, that the village of Tiṭṭai, the gift of 5 vēli of land in the places they selected in Kaṇḍiyūr-nāḍu, for the conduct of a festival on the day of Uttarāḍāḍi in the month of Āṇi, the natal star of the king, and the temple, should bear the name called the Āvaṇivandāṉ-maṇḍapa in the temple. The writing seems to belong to the 14th century A.D.

cells.date: 5th year (in words), Kumbha, be. pañ-chami, Saturday, Šđdi.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions the Nāṭṭār and the Mahājanas of Tiṭṭai-vaḷanāḍu, and states that a certain stone built into the same wall which is in modern characters, states that Tiṭṭai belongs to (the god) Tēriṇūr (Tēruṇūr). cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TANJORE TALUK · TANJORE TALUK. Tiṭṭai † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the outer maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine, right of entrance.
cells.remarks: States that the wall was the gift of Uḍaiyār Chōḷadēyār. The writing belongs to the 13th century A.D.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TANJORE TALUK · TANJORE TALUK. Tiṭṭai † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the same maṇḍapa
cells.remarks: States that the maṇḍapa was the gift of a vēḷaikkāra of the temple of Kulōttuṅgachōḷīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār at Paruṅgūr, who bears a few birudas like Ēdirilāyirār, Śatturukār etc. On another side of the same pillar it is recorded regarding the gift, by the Ūrār of Peruṅgūr, of their pūḍik-kāl on certain dēvadāna lands in favour of the temple for its repairs. The writing of both belongs to the 13th century A.D.

cells.place: On a slab set up in a street.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TANJORE TALUK · Kurijil — Tamil Nadu

The gift was made by Dōvapa, son of Koṇḍapa Timmaṇa, the sthānīka of the Nārasādeva temple to a certain Nārasādeva, son of Alapa for digging a tank in which belonged to the temple and the land in the village of Guṇḍalhalli including the surrounding lands under cultivation. A portion of the land was also given to the same person as daśabandham under certain stipulations.

cells.location: SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TANJORE TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north side of the same boulder.

In the charaeters of the 18th century A.D.

cells.location: NELLORE DISTRICT / ATMAKUR TALUK · ATMAKUR TALUK. Bōyila-Chiruvella — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone-cross set up on a Christian tomb on the ‘Samādhi-dibba’ mound.

cells.place: Bakkal.—Broken slab in the compound of the Satyanāthēśvara temple.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Bakkal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone in the danada bayalu

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Bakkal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone (No. I) set up in the compound of the Satyanāthēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. Mentions the god Gōkarṇa-Mahābala and paṭṭamahādēvi Laliyādēvi. Seems to record the gift of some money in memory of a warrior who died in a fight. Mentions also Durgādēvi and Kāmadēvi. These were perhaps his wives.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Bakkal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another hero-stone (No. II) at the same place.
cells.remarks: Partly broken and damaged. In characters of about the 12th century A.D. Mentions a Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara who was a worshipper of the god Mahābala of Gōkarṇa and seems to record the death of Mēdagandana Bivarasa of Bakkaṇa in the battle at Punije. Mentions Pradhāna Sāmtavēg-gēḍe, Bommayya-nāyaka, the younger brother of Mēḍagauḍa and Banavase Bairōja.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Barūr — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. The characters, belong to about the 12th century A. D. Refers to the 'Guttiyarājya' and one Masaneyanāyaka's son (name lost) who probably died in a battle.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Barūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another hero-stone (No. II) at the same place.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Barūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another hero-stone (No. III) at the same place.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Bāḷahaḷḷi — Karnataka

The cyclic year Śubhakṛit did not correspond to Chāḷukya-Vikrama year 45 as quoted in the record but to 47. See No. 22 above. [from date-calculation appendix, No. 8]
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. In characters of about the 17th century A.D. Mentions-Biragauḍa of Bāḷahaḷḷi.

cells.remarks: In characters of about the 18th century A.D. Mentions the stone-cutter (kaḷakuṭaka) Dēvaya.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Chaḷgar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone lying in the same forest
cells.remarks: Indifferently written and damaged. Seems to record the death of a follower of Ārasappa-Nāyaka. Refers to Beḷugoḷa.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Chaḷgar † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Describes the heroic qualities of Dānavinōda Vairi-Nārāyaṇa Lenkamasaṇya Ādityavarma and registers the construction of a pillar by the local residents of the Kāpūr-gapa and the Mēśā pāṣāṇa-gachchha.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Chaḷgar † — Karnataka
cells.place: On a stone lying in front of the temple of Basavaṇṇa.
cells.remarks: States that this is the private property (svāmi) of Bhīmā-chārya, son of Kāgi Śrīnivāsāchārya of Kāgiṇolli.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Chaḷgar † — Karnataka

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / SIRSI TALUK · Chaḷgar † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Records the death of Ekkatiiga Rājanṇa, the younger brother of Malleya-Nāvaka of Jidugūru on the occasion of the siege of the village Hāhanūr by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Bittiṇyarasa.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / HURLI TALUK · HURLI TALUK. Siruguppi — Karnataka
cells.place: On a stone lying near the temple of Huḍēda Hanumān.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / HURLI TALUK · HURLI TALUK. Siruguppi † — Karnataka
cells.place: On a stone leaning against the back wall of the temple of Kiṭṭada-Hanumān.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / HURLI TALUK · HURLI TALUK. Siruguppi † — Karnataka
cells.place: On a stone lying in the village chāvaḍi.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 13th century A.D. States that this Brahmapurī was established by Daṇḍanāyaka Nigarasa, son of Sōdēva of Ayyāvoḷe. Below the inscription is a carving of the Vāmanāvatāra holding the umbrella.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / HURLI TALUK · HURLI TALUK. Siruguppi † — Karnataka
cells.place: On a slab lying in the same place

cells.remarks: Much damaged. Praises Siriguppe in Boḷvala-dēśa. Refers to the One Hundred Mahājanas of the place and the learned body of Thirty-four, who were well-versed in the several Vēdas, śāstras, etc. Refers also to the gift of land made to the locality. Seems to register a gift of land made to the temple of Viṣṇu, for offerings, repairs, etc.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / HURLI TALUK · Yaraguppi — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land made to the Two-Hundred-and-Fifty-two, by the Ūroḍeya Nākara and Mannēya Indrakēśamaya, for the benefit of the wall called arabāvi constructed by Kēśamayya-prabhu when Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Mārarasa was administering the Two Six-hundred districts.

cells.location: NORTH KANARA DISTRICT / HAVERI TALUK · HAVERI TALUK. Bammaṇahalli — Karnataka
cells.place: On a hero-stone standing in Survey No. 122.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 11th century A.D. Records that Kēśava, a servant of the king, built a big tank to the west of Negeyūr and states that he pierced to death by thieves while he was escorting his wives to a distant village. This stone was consequently set up by his mother Kambakke and others at Bambadi (?).

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · DHARWAR DISTRICT — Karnataka
cells.place: cont. HAVERI TALUK—cont. Bammankaṭi—cont. On a slab standing near the above.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Seems to record a gift of land (?) made for the renovation, etc., of a temple (name lost) by Mahāmaṇdalēśvara Vira-Vikramādityadēva in conjunction with [Mahā]pradhana Dāsamarasa, Sandhivigrahi Bammiyaṇṇa, Tantrapāla Viṭṭayya and Daṇdanūyaka Kēśavadēva in the presence of Rāja-guru Kalyānadēva at the capital city Guttojal, when Daṇdanūyaka Bammadēvarusa was governing all the countries in Kuntala-dēśa. Incidentally praises the family of the Guttamaṇdalēśvara of Banavase Twelve Thousand.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · DHARWAR DISTRICT † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that this is the mānya (land) of Lingapu, son of Sūrapa, probably the Syānabhōga (accountant) of Bommanakaṭi.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · Belvaḷi — Karnataka

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · Biḷjūr — Karnataka
cells.place: On a stone standing in Survey No. 36.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 10th century A.D. Badly damaged and mutilated. Seems to record a gift of land. Mentions Bijjūru and Banavāsi-12,000. Seems also to refer to a local Chajuki chief.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · Gaḷagānāth — Karnataka
cells.place: On a slab set up in the temple of Gaḷagēśvara.

cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers the renewal of the gift (Punardatti) of (the village) Pulluni in Belhuge-70 made to the temple of Galagēśvara by Mahāmaṇdalēśvara Channarsa who was governing Belhuge-70, the Thirty-six (division) Pannirppalli, Kondavaṭi and the country from Ābalige-nādu to Hayve, from his capital at Banavase-kōṭe, under Yuvarāja Trailōkyamalla Vira-Nolamba Pallava Permānadi Jayasinghadēva, the king's brother. Describes the conquests of the Chōla, Lāla and other kings achieved by Vira-Nolamba.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · Gaḷagānāth † — Karnataka
cells.place: On another slab standing in the same temple.
cells.date: Chāljukya - Vikrama year, 3, Siddhārthin, Chaitra, śu. puṇname, Sunday, saṅkrānti. cells.remarks: Records the gift of thirty gadyānas made by Mokari Bammayya, the subordinate of Vira-Nolamba for constructing a mandapa in the temple of Galagēśvara at Phalluni-tīrtha for the merit of his mother Jōgiyabbe, when Trailōkyamalla Vira-Nolamba Pallava Permānadi was governing the Two Six-hundreds, Banavāsi-12,000, Sāntaļige-1,000, etc.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · Gaḷagānāth † — Karnataka
cells.place: On a third slab standing in the same temple.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · Gaḷagānāth † — Karnataka
cells.place: On a broken stone lying in the same place.

cells.location: DHARWAR DISTRICT · Gaḷagānāth † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Records the death of Mallappa in a fight. Characters belong to the 14th century A.D.
